name: seo-autopilot
description: Git-native, approval-first SEO maintenance that converts evidence-backed findings into validated pull requests.

scripts.reconcile: pnpm --filter @seo-autopilot/core build && pnpm --filter @seo-autopilot/connectors build && pnpm --filter @seo-autopilot/database build && pnpm --filter @seo-autopilot/worker reconcile
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @seo-autopilot/core build && pnpm --filter @seo-autopilot/connectors build && pnpm --filter @seo-autopilot/site-adapters build && pnpm --filter @seo-autopilot/database build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.scan: pnpm --filter @seo-autopilot/core build && pnpm --filter @seo-autopilot/connectors build && pnpm --filter @seo-autopilot/site-adapters build && pnpm --filter @seo-autopilot/cli start
